relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX is an ultrapotent capsaicin analog with a broad therapeutic window, allowing for the full desensitization of TRPV1-expressing sensory afferents by means of a single injection [69].

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX can also ablate sensory neurons, causing permanent analgesia [175,176,177].

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: RTX, however, did deplete substance P (SP) and CGRP from bladder afferents [88,122].

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, TRPV1 is a downstream target for pain-producing substances such as bradykinin [44].

relationships.subject: resiniferatoxin
relationships.evidence_quote: substance P, a neuropeptide produced by sensory neurons that plays an important role in pain transduction, is down-regulated after RTX challenge [85]

key_findings: RTX is an ultrapotent TRPV1 agonist with a wider therapeutic window than capsaicin, enabling desensitization or ablation of TRPV1-positive afferents.
Clinical applications include intravesical RTX for detrusor overactivity, intrathecal/epidural RTX for cancer pain and intra-articular RTX for knee osteoarthritis.
